_why: /for-installer/ promises that pairing is 'checked against manufacturer lists before it ships'. It never showed the lists. BayWa r.e. and Memodo both publish a compatibility matrix. This file is the evidence base for ours. Every retained cell traces to the cited manufacturer document; record a version or date only where the file itself establishes it. de-linker tested none of it. de-linker has no lab. The sentence 'The compatibility matrix is confirmed in de-linker's lab' was deleted from this site on 2026-07-12; this file exists so it is never re-created in the shape of a table.
_rule: Each cell states only what its cited documents establish. 'listed' requires a model-level maker listing; 'one_way' records which side lists it; 'not_listed' means the cited documents do not name the pair and does not prove incompatibility; 'closed' requires direct manufacturer evidence that the relevant hardware has no interface for the proposed pairing. Never infer a closed system or a global absence of publications from a component table.

_states.listed: Listed by <MAKER>. A cited manufacturer document names this exact pair. Record the version and date only when the document itself establishes them.
_states.one_way: Listed one-way. A cited document from <A> lists the pair; the cited document from <B> does not. Record which side lists it and the exact scope of the documents checked.
_states.not_listed: The cited documents do not list this pair. This does not establish compatibility or incompatibility and makes no claim about documents not checked.
_states.closed: The cited manufacturer document directly establishes that the relevant connection is unavailable. Absence from a component table is insufficient.

_documents_exclude: A not_listed cell whose cited documents themselves speak against the pair: an N/A mark, 'only X is compatible', voltages that do not meet. The answer states what the documents state and does not add that the absence is no statement about whether the combination works. It is not 'closed', which needs evidence that the hardware has no interface.

saj-h2-t3|saj-bat.battery_label: SAJ B2 / BU2 / BC2 HV series
saj-h2-t3|saj-bat.constraint: SAJ's Configuration Instructions V1.0 (Section 2) give the H2 series system as H2 + BC2 + BU2. SAJ's B2 datasheet names B2-5.0 to B2-25.0 as one to five BU2-5.0 modules with one BC2-HV1 control module, and SAJ's B2 manual (V1.2, PDF p5) says the B2 can only be used as a set with SAJ's H2 high voltage series storage inverter. The listing does not cover the one-module B2-5.0, whose operating voltage lies below the H2 T3's battery voltage range.
saj-h2-t3|saj-bat.constraint_de: Die SAJ-Konfigurationsanleitung V1.0 (Abschnitt 2) gibt das System der H2-Serie als H2 + BC2 + BU2 an. Das SAJ-Datenblatt der B2 nennt B2-5.0 bis B2-25.0 als ein bis fünf BU2-5.0-Module mit einem Steuermodul BC2-HV1, und das SAJ-Handbuch der B2 (V1.2, PDF-S. 5) gibt an, dass die B2 nur im Verbund mit dem Hochvolt-Speicherwechselrichter der SAJ-H2-Serie eingesetzt werden kann. Die Listung umfasst die B2-5.0 mit einem Modul nicht; ihre Betriebsspannung liegt unter dem Batteriespannungsbereich des H2 T3.

model_constraints.conclusion: The one-module B2-5.0 does not run on the H2 T3: SAJ's B2 datasheet gives it 89.6 to 115.2 V, below the battery voltage range of 180 to 800 V in the H2 T3 manual.
model_constraints.conclusion_de: Die B2-5.0 mit einem Modul läuft nicht am H2 T3: Das SAJ-Datenblatt der B2 gibt für sie 89,6 bis 115,2 V an, unterhalb des Batteriespannungsbereichs von 180 bis 800 V im H2-T3-Handbuch.

_stack_range_why: Pylontech's FH1/FH2/FH3/RM columns are stackable module quantities, min to max. 2-7 means a MINIMUM of 2 as well as a maximum of 7. The build script reads the module count out of our own SKU names (Force-H3 25.6 kWh (5 x FH10050) = 5) and prints, in the cell, which of the batteries we actually sell fall outside the range Pylontech published. That is the difference between a table and a liability.
